Ankit Kumar Jena .... Petitioner

Mr. D. Das, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
 Mr. P.K. Maharaj, Asc
 Mr. S.K. Routray, Adv (Informant)
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
21.06.2023 Order No.
01. 1.
Learned counsel Mr. S.K. Routray and associates have filed Vakalatnama on behalf of the informant-Prabir Barik.
Name of Mr. Routray and associates be reflected in the file as well as in the cause list and in the CMS of this Court.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the informant and learned counsel for the State.
3. The petitioner is an accused in connection with G.R. Case No.476 of 2023, pending before the Court of the learned J.M.F.C.(IV), Cuttack arising out of Madhupatna P.S. Case No.160 of 2023 for alleged commission of offences under Sections 418/420/403/467/468/471/120B/34 of IPC.
4.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C. by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, (LR & LTV), Cuttack by order dated 29.05.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5. Learned counsel for the informant files an affidavit indicating that the matter has been amicably settled inter se between the Parties.
The same is taken on record.
6. Taking note of the same, this Court directs the petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned Court in seisin.
